title: May Admin — Investigation Dashboard Backend Specification
status: DESIGN — Backend data model specification. Implementation deferred to Phase 1 Build dashboard frontend.
purpose: Define the complete backend data model that powers the May Admin investigation dashboard. This specification describes the Unified Investigation Object — a single JSON representation that integrates data from all 5 registries and provides a complete view of any question's administrative state.
authority: Derived from S252-S259 validated infrastructure. All FKs verified with 0 broken relationships at S260 T0.

investigatorDossier.description: Per-question complete investigation view. Equivalent to the 9-section dossier from question_investigation_api.js, augmented with cross-entity drill-down links.
sections: 1_identity — Who is this question? (pack, section, domain, topic, difficulty, cognitive level, state)
2_content — What does it ask? (stem, choices, correct answer, explanations)
3_health — How healthy is it? (score, tier, component breakdown, diagnosis)
4_defects — What defects affect it? (defect codes, severity, status)
5_challenges — Has anyone challenged it? (CH-IDs, types, triage classification)
6_recommendations — What should be done? (REC-IDs, severity, status)
7_sessions — When was it worked on? (session IDs, modes, dates)
8_certifications — When was it certified? (certification events, batches)

investigationQueue.description: Filterable list of all 19 investigations with status, priority, and linked entities.

challengeQueue.description: Filterable list of all 35 challenges with triage classification and resolution status.

questionHealthDashboard.description: Aggregate view of the 2,540-item health landscape.

sessionTimeline.description: 40-session development history with linked QIDs and outcomes.

dataIntegrationModel.description: The dashboard backend integrates 5 registries + 1 pack-file layer into a single query surface. The UnifiedInvestigationObject is the canonical representation — see SESSION260_OBJECT_MODEL.json for the complete schema.

dataSources.question_history.json: Identity, state, timeline, sessions, challenges, defects, recommendations, certifications — 2,540 QIDs
dataSources.investigation_registry.json: 19 investigations with linked QIDs, challenges, defects, recommendations, sessions — lifecycle state machine
dataSources.challenge_registry.json: 35 challenges with linked QIDs, sessions, recommendations — triage classification via challenge_triage.json
dataSources.recommendation_registry.json: 5 REC-IDs with 2,482 total QID target links — severity, status, source defect
dataSources.session_registry.json: 40 sessions with QID lists — mode, series, title, date
dataSources.pack_*_corrected.js: Live content: stem, choices, correctChoice, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrong[A-D], question_state (authoritative source)

summary.totalRelationshipsChecked: 3,793 (16 INV→CH + 24 INV→REC + 26 INV→QID + 35 CH→QID + 35 CH→SESS + 1,163 SESS→QID + 2,482 REC→QID + 12 cross-registry)
summary.verdict: PASS — 0 broken relationships across all FK links

selfAssessment.criterion: S261 can code the dashboard frontend from this document alone
selfAssessment.result: PARTIALLY READY — The backend data model and FK relationships are fully specified and validated. The UnifiedInvestigationObject schema (SESSION260_OBJECT_MODEL.json) defines every field with its data source and FK. A frontend developer can consume this specification to build view components. However, rendering decisions (component library, layout, interactivity) are not specified — this is a data contract, not a UI specification.
selfAssessment.gapsForS261: None — S261 validates workflows against live registries, not against dashboard UI. The data model is complete for administrative workflow certification.
